title: 面向智能体AI系统的目标级能耗核算方法
summary: 提出A-LEMS框架，将AI能耗计量从每次推理能耗重新定义为每个成功目标能耗（EpG），并定义编排开销指数（OOI）。实验表明，智能体工作流能耗是线性基线的4.33倍，且开销主要由编排结构而非推理计算驱动。
summary_en: Proposes A-LEMS framework redefining AI energy accounting from energy per inference to Energy per Successful Goal (EpG), and defines Orchestration Overhead Index (OOI). Experiments show agentic workflows consume 4.33x more energy than linear baselines, driven by orchestration structure.
